corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez infinitive/verbal noun ዐቂበቶሙ begins with 1st-order ዐ (matching ዐቂበተክሙ in L24) and the printed glyph is a clean loop ዐ without the 6th-order top hook of ዕ.
